resolution: Resolution of the ancillary data (in meters)
start_date: Lower bound of the time range for downloading thermal data (YYYY-MM-DD)
end_date: Higher bound of the time range for downloading thermal data (YYYY-MM-DD)
larger_bbox_size_km: Extent of the area considered for thermal data (in km)
DTC_alpha_1: Regularisation parameter for the DTC model: penalises non-monotonic decrease between the zenith and the end of the cycle
DTC_alpha_2: Regularisation parameter for the DTC model: penalises values at the thermal zenith (maximum LST of the day) lower than the observed maximum LST
DTC_sunset_shift: Hyper-parameter for the DTC model: defines the thermal sunset (limit between day/night conditions) relative to the actual sunset (the Sun goes below the horizon). The shift is negative.
fusion_window_size: Size of the sliding window used for spatio-temporal unmixing.
fusion_alpha_time: Hyper-parameter for the spatio-temporal unmixing: Weights the importance of the distance to the central pixel of the sliding window.
fusion_alpha_space: Hyper-parameter for the spatio-temporal unmixing: Weights the importance of the difference of time of the day between the target coarse LST and the fine LSTs used.
fusion_k: Hyper-parameter for the spatio-temporal unmixing: Changes the tolerance in terms of the standard deviation of the considered features (NDVI, NDWI, ENDISI, LST) defining similarity.
super_resolution_train_size: Size of the training and validation sets compared to the testing set for the super-resolution model. In proportion between 0 and 1.
super_resolution_valid_size: Size of the validation set compared to the training set. Between 0 and 1.
super_resolution_max_epochs: Maximum number of epochs to iterate for the super-resolution model.
super_resolution_batch_size: Batch size for the super-resolution model.
super_resolution_patch_size: Size in pixels of the patches to be used for the super-resolution model.
super_resolution_learning_rate: Learning rate of the super-resolution model.
super_resolution_lambda_ssim: Hyper-parameter of the super-resolution model, weighting the SSIM loss.
geostationary_data_path: Path to the pre-downlaoded geostationary data.
